::: {#def-bootstrap-se}
#### Bootstrap standard error

The **bootstrap standard error** of a statistic $\hat\theta$,
written $\widehat{\text{SE}}_\text{boot}$,
is the sample standard deviation of the bootstrap replicates
$\hat\theta^*_1, \ldots, \hat\theta^*_B$
(@def-bootstrap-distribution).
It estimates the [standard error](estimation.qmd#def-SE) of $\hat\theta$.
:::
